name: ngo-challenge-advisor
description: Guides NGOs through a click-first adaptive interview to publish structured WorkBuddy co-creation cards.

displayDescription.en: Turns real NGO work pain points into clear, actionable co-creation cards through adaptive, click-first interviews and publication checks.
displayDescription.zh: 通过点击式访谈梳理 NGO 真实工作痛点，生成清晰可执行的共创卡，并在发布前完成适配、边界与质量检查。

defaultInitPrompt.en: Help me turn an NGO work pain point into a co-creation card

quickPrompts.zh: 帮我从几个 NGO 痛点中选出最适合发布的一张

quickPrompts.zh: 帮我检查这张 NGO 共创卡是否已经适合发布
